answer: Before each dawn, every identity must file a quartz-hard sonnet: a short log of its last epoch's productive work, co-signed by two independent clients. A sybil operator must fabricate convincing, client-signed logs for every fake identity, and logs cross-check against real client records. The nth fake costs n^2 x 5 credits in expected forfeits: one fake risks 5 credits, ten fakes risk 500, because one exposed log flags the whole correlated cluster and all its bonds burn.
